items.exampleEn: The teacher rejected his excuse for being late.
items.exampleZh: 老師不接受他遲到的理由。

items.exampleEn: His honest answer convinced me that he was right.
items.exampleZh: 他誠實的回答讓我相信他是對的。

items.exampleEn: The manager approved my vacation request.
items.exampleZh: 經理核准了我的休假申請。

items.exampleEn: If the bus is late, we need an alternative plan.
items.exampleZh: 如果公車誤點，我們需要另一個方案。

items.exampleEn: Many people regard this park as the best place to relax.
items.exampleZh: 很多人把這座公園視為最好的放鬆地點。

items.exampleEn: The police are still looking for the suspect.
Everyone has a different definition of happiness.
items.exampleZh: 每個人對幸福的定義都不一樣。

items.exampleEn: I suppose we should leave before it gets dark.
items.exampleZh: 我想我們應該在天黑前離開。

items.sentenceEn: The suspect said he was at home all night.
items.sentenceZh: 那名嫌犯說他整晚都在家。

items.audioEn: The meeting room is busy, so the alternative is to meet in the cafe.
items.audioZh: 會議室有人在用，所以另一個選擇是在咖啡店碰面。
items.questionZh: 他們可能會在哪裡開會？

items.sentenceEn: She was rejected by three companies before she found this job.
items.sentenceZh: 找到這份工作之前，她被三家公司拒絕過。

items.sentenceEn: It took a long time to convince him that the plan was safe.
items.sentenceZh: 花了很長時間才讓他相信這個計畫是安全的。

items.stemEn: The city finally ____ the plan to build a new library.
items.stemZh: 市政府終於批准了興建新圖書館的計畫。

items.stemEn: What is the ____ of "freedom" in this dictionary?
items.stemZh: 這本字典裡「自由」的定義是什麼？

items.passageEn: Mia wanted to work from home two days a week. Her manager first rejected the idea, because he regarded working in the office as important. Mia did not give up. She wrote a short report with clearly defined goals and an alternative plan for team meetings. "I suppose we can try it for a month," her manager said. After one month, the results were incredibly good. They convinced him, and he approved her plan. Now other workers want to do the same thing.
items.passageZh: Mia 想每週在家工作兩天。她的經理一開始拒絕了，因為他認為在辦公室上班很重要。Mia 沒有放棄。她寫了一份簡短的報告，目標訂得很清楚，並提出團隊開會的替代方案。經理說：「我想我們可以試一個月。」一個月後，結果好得令人難以置信。這說服了他，他批准了她的計畫。現在其他同事也想比照辦理。

questions.questionZh: 經理一開始為什麼拒絕？
options: 公司的規定不允許這樣
他認為進辦公室很重要

items.promptZh: 我認為他是我最好的朋友。
referenceEn: I regard him as my best friend.
I have always regarded him as my best friend.
rubricZh: regard A as B，表示「把 A 視為 B」，as 不可少
說的是現在的看法，時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式、現在完成式等）
寫 I think he is my best friend. 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 我們沒辦法說服她留下來。
referenceEn: We couldn't convince her to stay.
We were not able to convince her to stay.
rubricZh: 用 convince＋人＋to＋原形動詞表示「說服某人做某事」（寫 persuade 也正確）
「沒辦法」可寫，例如 couldn't、weren't able to 等
